TEXT: Yesterday, Manami told me, "There's something I want to tell you." So we headed to the park along the way home.
...I guess even unusual things do happen, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, there's something I want to talk about. May I?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's with the formality? Besides, that's why we're here right? Just go ahead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yes, thank you. You see, actually--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? A phone call? Sorry Manami, wait a minute.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: S-Sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hello?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Answer immediately when I call you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh Kirino, is it? It's rare to get calls from you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's an emergency, so I have no other choice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Emergency...? Did something happen?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-Well! Moments ago, there was a sudden announcement on the blog!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? What's that? Blog announcement?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Like I said～! It says they're holding a Meruru event right now in Akihabara--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, I get it now... "That" kind of emergency.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What's wrong with..."that"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: At the moment, I already have plans that I can't just drop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh? Why didn't I hear anything about this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's because I didn't tell you. Do I have to report to you now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wha, why are you so cocky--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anyways, I can't come right now. If you want to go to Akiba, ask Kuroneko or someone else.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey! Hold it right there! First of all, I didn't even say one word about wanting to go to Akiba with you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah. I'm hanging up--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *sigh*...
Geez, that Kirino... Only she would think of that as an emergency...
I bet she just sees me as a servant to order around.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hey, was that Kirino-chan just now?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Perhaps... that was an important matter...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, it's okay. It wasn't anything important.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is... that so? That's fine then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: More importantly, let's continue. So, what was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh, well. Actually--

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I need some life counseling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I know, right?! I totally knew you'd say that! There's no way you'd betray the development! On the contrary, how refreshing!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, what's wrong?! You suddenly seem very excited!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, just talking to myself, just ignore it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm, so... you want some life counseling from me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's not about you cutting your hair too short again, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's not about that! It's something more important!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm... Okay, I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hm? Somehow, you suddenly look very serious about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I guess so. I kinda realized that everyone worries about the most unexpected things.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh～? I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So? What's the life counseling about?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...There!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? What are you doing, pointing your finger at me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...This!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: *nodnod*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How troublesome! Ah well.  My... what?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's about... relationships.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Relationships? So that's what this life counseling is about?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Y-Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't understand this at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well... lately, you seem to have been meeting and getting along with a lot of people, and they are all very cute girls...
Hmm... Now that she mentions it, that's certainly true.
Ever since Kirino's life counseling. I met Kuroneko, Saori, as well as Ayase, etc...
If I think carefully, it's all girls.
...In fact, isn't this the most popular I've ever been in my life?
...As if.
Kirino is my little sister, while Kuroneko is... *c-cough*! Kirino's otaku friend. Nothing more, nothing less.
The same holds true for Saori with her swirly glasses, and Ayase has reached the point where she strongly wants to erase me from society.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Also, recently, you haven't been going to the library as much anymore. That's why... it got me a little bit worried...
Manami is saying "a little bit"...
But because we've been together for a long time, I know that she's pretty worried when she actually voices her thoughts.
Indeed, she's worried about how I haven't been putting much effort in studying for the exams lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami, you really got the wrong idea. There's no way I can be popular!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You have a kind, gentle and caring attitude. And I believe that girls want to rely on you for that reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's that? You're awfully generous with the praises today.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I've always thought that about you! So... it's making me a little worried.
...Worried? Ahh, so it's not about studying for the exams, but about being seen with one girl after another? And that they're Kirino's friends too...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI

T-The fact that your childhood friend is worrying about how you 'might do something to your little sister's friends' is no joke!
